ablations.both: delta * shadowKeep * (1 + rimLevelGain * squaredRimWeight * lit * along)

formula: delta * shadowKeep * (1 + rimLevelGain * squaredRimWeight * lit * along)
limitations: The group/source DC solve is source-owned; no coefficient is fitted to candidate pixels.
The predicted image starts from an 8-bit current capture, not the unrounded shader buffer.
The oracle uses float64 geometry, finite-difference normals and NumPy ties-to-even rounding; WGSL float32, pixel coverage and browser quantization are not replicated bit-exactly.
Coverage reconstruction assumes a black edge backdrop; this is asserted for every cell.
The mask is the production un-eroded native luminance-delta mask inside the declared circular rounded rectangle; deep counts use the renderer continuous SDF, not mask erosion.
The dark32 body is below the mask threshold. Full-silhouette T1 is often rim-heavy and is not an isolated deep-body transfer function.
Current/native frozen-reference-record numeric identities are JSON record binders, not PNG byte hashes. OriginalCapture pins authenticate those images separately.
Residuals remain unexplained; matching directions and rough magnitude do not prove a W52 operator passes per-cell, aggregate, tint, CSS or exposure contracts.
meaning: Offline reconstruction of W51, not a rendered W52 candidate or acceptance result.
